To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
plant sterol intake does not interfere with brain function and behavior in a mouse model of phytosterolemics.

(1) plant sterol accumulation in the brains of ABCG5/ABCG8 knockout mice does not interfere with learning and memory functions; (2) plant sterol enriched diet is not contra-indicated for the elderly; (3) the swimming speed of Abcg5/Abcg8 knockout mice is higher compared to wild type mice; and (4) the cholesterol metabolism in the brains of these knockout mice is affected.
dietary plant sterols accumulate to high levels in the brain of Abcg5-deficient mice without interfering with memory and anxiety related behavior.
